systems.platform: Digital portal of the Direção Geral do Registo e Notariado, drawing on the Sistema Integrado de Gestão de Assentos (SIGA)
systems.owner: Direção Geral do Registo e Notariado, with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
systems.tiers: Embassy in Portugal from April 2025; other embassies promised during 2025. Issues birth certificates, identity cards, criminal record certificates and certificates of capacity to marry

note: A portal through which citizens abroad request civil documents, the criminal record certificate among them; it is the registries directorate's, of class public, and the document states nothing on police or station records.
